'''''Poltroon''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]] used by a [[AZ 77 (Venzeiia 2)|salvage yard]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The platform was harboring a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] that was tracked by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who wanted the spy alive. The platform was also responsible for hiding fugitives and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] all of which had [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transports]] that were modified for extra speed. The '''Poltroon''' was tasked in repairing the [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] ''[[Nemzet]]'' and the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Renspecs]]''. Whether the shuttle managed to do this is unclear, but what was clear was that the shuttle destroyed in the skirmish. The events regarding '''AZ 77''' were recorded for the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
